This shift in momentum likely gave Cape Verde an edge in the latter part of the match, as they were able to create more scoring opportunities. Overall, Cape Verde benefited more from the hydration breaks, particularly the second one, as they were able to regain and increase their attacking intensity, potentially impacting the match's outcome.
